headline: Only six stocks from the 1990 Sensex survive in the benchmark today, warns S Naren
hook: Six survivors left in the 1990 Sensex
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund's S Naren highlighted that out of the original 1990 Sensex, only six companies remain in the benchmark index. Speaking at the ET Wealth Expo, he cautioned investors against chasing past returns and warned that severely beaten-down stocks may never recover. He emphasized the crucial distinction between proper asset allocation and mere stock selection. Indian retail investors should note this warning to avoid concentration risk and rethink their long-term equity strategies.
why_it_matters: Reassess portfolio diversification to survive long-term index changes.
